title: Procedural Instanced Forest with LOD
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that renders a procedural instanced-mesh forest with a multi-level LOD (Level of Detail) system.

## Scene Setup
- Dark green ground plane (200x200 units) at y=0.
- PerspectiveCamera starting at position (0, 40, 80), looking at origin.
- DirectionalLight from (50, 80, 30) with intensity 1.0, plus a soft AmbientLight (intensity 0.35).
- Sky-blue background color (#87CEEB).

## Tree Generation
- Generate exactly 3000 trees placed randomly on the ground plane within a radius of 90 units from the origin. Use a seeded pseudo-random generator (seed=42) so positions are deterministic.
- Each tree is composed of a trunk (CylinderGeometry) and a canopy (ConeGeometry). Use brown (#8B4513) for trunks and randomized greens (hue 100-140 in HSL, saturation 0.5-0.8, lightness 0.25-0.45) for canopies.
- Trees have random scale between 0.6 and 1.4 and random Y-axis rotation.

## LOD System (3 levels)
- LOD 0 (High): Full detail. Trunk: CylinderGeometry(0.3, 0.4, 3, 8). Canopy: ConeGeometry(1.8, 4, 8). Used when distance from camera < 30 units.
- LOD 1 (Medium): Reduced. Trunk: CylinderGeometry(0.3, 0.4, 3, 4). Canopy: ConeGeometry(1.8, 4, 4). Used when distance 30-60 units.
- LOD 2 (Low): Minimal. Single merged ConeGeometry(1.5, 6, 3) in green, no separate trunk. Used when distance >= 60 units.
- Use THREE.InstancedMesh for each LOD level (so 3 instanced meshes for canopies + 2 for trunks at LOD0/LOD1, plus 1 combined mesh for LOD2). Update instance counts and matrices each frame based on camera distance to each tree position.
- Track and expose the count of trees in each LOD bucket.

## Camera Controls
- Implement orbit-style controls: left-click drag rotates, scroll wheel zooms (clamp distance 10-150).
- Keyboard: W/S move camera forward/backward along its look direction (speed 0.8/frame). A/D strafe left/right.
- Press 'F' to toggle a wireframe debug mode on all meshes.
- Press 'L' to cycle through LOD lock modes: 'auto' (default distance-based), 'lock0' (force all LOD0), 'lock1' (force all LOD1), 'lock2' (force all LOD2).

## Frustum Culling
- Implement manual frustum culling: only include trees whose positions are inside the camera frustum in the instanced mesh updates. Track the number of frustum-culled trees.

## HUD / UI
- Top-left HUD overlay (semi-transparent dark background, white monospace text) showing:
  - FPS (updated every 500ms)
  - Total trees: 3000
  - LOD0 count / LOD1 count / LOD2 count
  - Culled count (trees outside frustum)
  - Visible count (trees inside frustum)
  - Current LOD mode ('auto' | 'lock0' | 'lock1' | 'lock2')
  - Wireframe: on/off
  - Camera distance from origin
- A DOM button with id='btn-reset-camera' that resets camera to initial position/rotation.
- A DOM range slider with id='slider-lod-bias' (min=-30, max=30, step=1, default=0) that biases the LOD distance thresholds. Label it 'LOD Bias'. When bias=10, LOD0 threshold becomes 40, LOD1 becomes 70, etc.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ updated every frame with:
- totalTrees: 3000 (constant)
- lod0Count: number of trees currently rendered at LOD0
- lod1Count: number of trees currently rendered at LOD1
- lod2Count: number of trees currently rendered at LOD2
- culledCount: number of trees outside frustum
- visibleCount: lod0Count + lod1Count + lod2Count
- lodMode: 'auto' | 'lock0' | 'lock1' | 'lock2'
- wireframe: boolean
- cameraDistance: distance from camera to origin
- cameraPosition: {x, y, z}
- lodBias: current bias value from slider
- fps: current FPS value
- lodThresholds: {lod0Max, lod1Max} (base + bias applied)
- frameCount: incrementing frame counter
- groundPlaneExists: boolean
- instancedMeshCount: number of InstancedMesh objects in the scene
physics_constraints: LOD distribution must be consistent: lod0Count + lod1Count + lod2Count + culledCount === 3000 at all times (conservation of tree count). LOD thresholds must respect bias: lod0Max = 30 + bias, lod1Max = 60 + bias. Camera distance must always be within [10, 150]. All tree positions must be within radius 90 of origin. No NaN values in any state fields.
